criterion.title: Chat Interface Display - Public Access
criterion.given: I navigate to a bot's public chat URL (/chat/:bot_id)
criterion.then: I see: Chat window with bot name and avatar in header, Welcome message configured by bot owner (max 500 chars), Input field with placeholder "Ask a question...", Send button (enabled/disabled based on input), Clean responsive layout (mobile-first design)

criterion.title: Chat Interface Display - Loading State
criterion.then: I see a loading skeleton instead of broken layout AND no errors are displayed to user (logged server-side)

criterion.title: Message Sending - Optimistic Update
criterion.given: I type a question and press Enter or click Send
criterion.then: my message appears in chat immediately (optimistic update) AND typing indicator appears below my message AND input field is cleared and disabled

criterion.title: Response Streaming - Token Display
criterion.given: the AI response is being generated
criterion.when: tokens stream in via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
criterion.then: I see response appear token-by-token (streaming display) AND response is formatted with markdown support (bold, lists, code blocks) AND citations appear inline with format: [Source: Document Name]

criterion.title: Response Completion - Re-enable Input
criterion.then: typing indicator disappears AND input field is re-enabled AND focus returns to input for next question

criterion.title: Error Handling - User Friendly Messages
criterion.given: an error occurs during response generation
criterion.then: I see friendly error message: "Sorry, I encountered an issue. Please try again." AND message includes retry button AND full error details logged server-side (not shown to user)

criterion.title: Error Handling - Bot Not Found
criterion.when: I navigate to invalid bot URL
criterion.then: I see: "Bot not found or is not available" AND offered to return to home or contact support

criterion.title: Session History - Session Persistence
criterion.given: I am in a chat session
criterion.then: all messages persist in chat window for session duration AND chat history stored in browser localStorage (session-based) AND messages survive page refresh within same session

criterion.title: Session History - Session Clearing
criterion.given: I close chat window or leave the page
criterion.then: chat history is cleared (session-based, not persistent) AND I start fresh conversation

criterion.title: Responsiveness - Mobile Touch Targets
criterion.given: I am using a mobile browser
criterion.then: all elements are touch-friendly (44x44px minimum) AND keyboard is not blocked by chat window AND scrolling works smoothly

criterion.title: Accessibility - Screen Reader Support
criterion.given: I am using a screen reader
criterion.then: messages announced with proper ARIA labels AND button roles are clear AND focus managed correctly (WCAG 2.1 AA)

criterion.title: Performance - Slow Network Resilience
criterion.given: I am on slow network connection
criterion.then: UI responds immediately (optimistic update) AND streaming begins within 2 seconds AND chat doesn't freeze or stutter

artifact.title: Epic & Story Breakdown
artifact.section: Epic 4: Chat Experience, Story 4.1: Web Chat Interface
artifact.snippet: As an End-user, I want to interact with a bot via a web-based chat interface, so that I can get answers to my questions. Chat displays AI responses with source citations. Chat maintains conversation context for follow-ups.
artifact.relevance: Complete specification and acceptance criteria for chat interface functionality

artifact.title: System Architecture
artifact.section: Frontend: Next.js 14, Backend: FastAPI, Vector Store: PostgreSQL + pgvector, Embeddings: Ollama
artifact.snippet: Frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router) — apps/web present. Backend: FastAPI (uvicorn) — apps/api present. Streaming patterns recommended for real-time token delivery to chat interfaces.
artifact.relevance: Architecture confirms Next.js frontend and FastAPI backend, provides streaming patterns for SSE implementation

artifact.title: Technical Specification
artifact.section: Frontend Stack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Backend: FastAPI with Ollama integration
artifact.snippet: Frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+). LLM: Ollama with Qwen 2.5 or llama3. Component library: shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS.
artifact.relevance: Confirms tech stack for chat components and styling conventions

artifact.title: UX Design Specification
artifact.section: Chat Interface Design: Cool Slate theme, responsive layout, accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA)
artifact.snippet: Cool Slate color theme with high contrast for accessibility. Mobile-first responsive design. 44x44px minimum touch targets for mobile. ARIA labels for screen readers.
artifact.relevance: Defines visual design system, color theme (Cool Slate), and accessibility requirements for chat interface

artifact.title: Context-Only Answer Generation
artifact.section: RAG Integration: Retrieves context, generates answers, provides citations
artifact.snippet: Story 3.2 provides the LLM endpoint that returns streamed responses with citations. Chat interface depends on this being completed first.
artifact.relevance: Blocker story that provides the RAG/LLM integration required for chat responses

artifact.title: Bot Isolation Enforcement
artifact.section: Bot Authorization Patterns: BotService.get_bot() for bot lookup and isolation
artifact.snippet: BotService.get_bot() validates bot ownership and applies RLS filtering. Reuse this pattern for public bot lookup in chat interface (check is_public flag instead of ownership).
artifact.relevance: Provides reusable bot service patterns and authorization logic for public bot access

artifact.reason: Reuse for public bot metadata lookup. Already implements bot retrieval with RLS filtering. Extend or create variant for public access (no ownership check, check is_public flag).
Bot model already exists from Story 2-1. Ensure is_public, welcome_message, and avatar_url fields are present. If not, add them.
Reference error handling and user feedback patterns used in existing bot management modals
Existing API patterns for bot endpoints. Follow same structure for /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/public and /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/chat/query
Existing API client library. Create chat.ts in this directory for SSE chat API integration
May need CORS headers for SSE public endpoint. Verify configuration supports streaming responses.

frontend.package: Install for markdown rendering in chat responses

backend.package: Optional: for caching bot metadata (5 min TTL)

constraints.constraint: Public API endpoint requires NO authentication, but must validate bot is public (is_public=true) before allowing chat queries
Session history stored client-side in localStorage only (not persistent server-side). Clear on page unload or explicit "Start New Conversation"
All responses streamed via Server-Sent Events (SSE), not WebSocket. Simpler, works with existing HTTP infrastructure.
XSS Prevention: Sanitize markdown input via react-markdown with safe defaults. Never render raw HTML.
Rate limiting: Consider limiting /chat/query endpoint (e.g., 10 req/min per IP) to prevent abuse
Bot isolation: All API endpoints must validate bot_id and check authorization (public access or ownership)
SSE tokens must be buffered and batched (every 100ms) to avoid excessive DOM updates on fast GPUs
UI must respond immediately to user message (optimistic update) before waiting for API response
All interactive elements must be 44x44px minimum (WCAG touch target size)
Chat interface must work with screen readers (ARIA labels, focus management, semantic HTML)
Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text (WCAG AA standard)
Mobile-first design: works on 320px width (iPhone SE) up to desktop (1920px)
Keyboard on mobile must not block send button or input field

interface.name: GET /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/public
interface.signature: GET /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/public -> 200 { name: str, avatar_url?: str, welcome_message: str, is_public: bool }
interface.notes: No authentication required. Returns 404 if bot not found. Returns 403 if is_public=false.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/chat/query
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/chat/query { query: str, context?: str[] } -> 200 text/event-stream
interface.notes: Streams response tokens as SSE events. Each event: data: {"token": "..."}\n\n. No authentication required.

interface.name: ChatMessage (Frontend)
interface.signature: interface ChatMessage { id: string; role: "user" | "assistant"; content: string; timestamp: number; citations?: Array<{source: string; url?: string}>; }
interface.notes: Used for session storage in localStorage and state management

interface.name: useChat() Hook
interface.signature: useChat(botId: string) -> { messages: ChatMessage[]; loading: bool; error?: string; sendMessage(query: str): void; clearHistory(): void; }
interface.notes: Manages chat state, localStorage persistence, API calls via EventSource

interface.name: ChatWindow Component
interface.notes: Main chat display component. Handles message rendering, auto-scroll, loading/error states

tests.standards: Follow test patterns from Story 2-2 (bot operations) and Story 2-8 (bot isolation). Unit tests isolate components with mocks. Integration tests verify API endpoints work correctly. E2E tests verify end-to-end workflow: navigate to chat → send message → stream tokens → verify display. Test frameworks: Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), pytest + FastAPI TestClient (backend). All tests must verify accessibility (ARIA labels, focus management) and mobile responsiveness (44px touch targets).
tests.locations: Frontend tests: apps/web/__tests__/ (Vitest discovers .test.tsx files). Backend tests: apps/api/tests/ (pytest discovers test_*.py files). E2E tests: apps/e2e/ (Playwright).
